description: Hand-labelled gold set for stance evaluation. 24 videos sampled from data/oriane/top10-all.json, stratified across candidates and across the baseline model's labels (12 unclear, 12 decisive). Labels: favorable / critical / neutral / irrelevant (the candidate is not actually discussed: OCR listicle, credit roll, foreign-language false positive) / ambiguous (present but irony or too little text).
labelledBy: manual review of caption + on-screen text + transcript, 2026-11-07
